supply_no_matching_dose.title: Tracked supply has no matching dose
supply_no_matching_dose.description: The supply "{medication}" for {patient} does not match the medications in any dose, so it will never decrement. Check the spelling in Configure (it must match a dose's medication exactly), or remove the supply.

user.title: Add a patient
user.description: Create a medication schedule for a pet or person. Pick the patient type (for the icon) and who should be reminded; you can add their doses next.

abort.already_configured: A patient with this name is already configured.

abort.no_doses: Add a dose first. There are no doses to edit yet.
abort.no_medications: Add a dose first. Medication detail attaches to a medication already used in one of this patient's doses.
abort.no_medication_detail: Add medication detail first. There is nothing to edit yet.
abort.no_supplies: Track a supply first. There is nothing to edit yet.

error.duplicate_dose: A dose with this time and these medications already exists. Use a different time, or combine them into one dose.
error.supply_exists: This medication already has a tracked supply. Use Edit a supply to change it.
error.invalid_time: One of the additional times is not a valid time. Use 24-hour HH:MM, separated by commas, e.g. 14:00, 20:00.
error.end_before_start: The end date is before the start date. Pick an end date on or after the start date, or clear one of them.

add_dose.title: Add a dose
add_dose.description: Pick the time and list the medications, then choose how it repeats: on chosen days of the week (all days = daily), every N days, an on/off cycle, or a relative/interval chain (N a day, each timed from when the last was taken), from a start date.

data.days: Days of the week (for the weekly option)
data.interval_days: Every N days (for the interval option)
data.relative_count: Doses per day (for the relative/interval option)
data.relative_offset_hours: Hours between doses (for the relative/interval option)
data.anchor_date: Start date (optional; no reminders before this date)
data.min_interval_hours: Minimum hours between doses (as-needed only; 0 = no limit)
data.max_per_day: Max doses per day (as-needed only; 0 = no limit)
data.end_date: End date (optional; no reminders after it)

data_description.meds: Separate multiple medications with &, +, or a comma. A slash only splits with spaces around it, so a name like 'Carbimazol 5mg (1/2)' stays whole.
data_description.min_interval_hours: For an as-needed medication, warn (never block) when it is logged again sooner than this many hours, e.g. a pain med no less than 4 hours apart.
data_description.max_per_day: For an as-needed medication, warn once this many doses have been logged today.
data_description.relative_offset_hours: For the relative/interval option: the first dose is at the time above, then each later dose becomes due this many hours after you mark the previous one taken, up to the doses-per-day count, resetting the next day. Good for 'every N hours' courses like antibiotics.
data_description.dose_units: Overrides the medication's default units per dose, for this dose only. Leave 0 to use the default; use decimals like 0.5 for half a pill.
data_description.ask_units: Turn on for a medication whose dose varies (e.g. adjusted from a reading). It adds an amount field you set before marking the dose given, and the supply decrements by that amount instead of the configured one. Off = always use the configured amount.
data_description.additional_times: Create the same dose at more than one time in one go, e.g. a twice-daily med. Enter extra 24-hour times separated by commas (14:00, 20:00); each becomes its own dose with the same medication, schedule, and options. Leave blank for a single time.
data_description.end_date: Optional. Stop reminding for this medication after this date, for a course with a set length (e.g. 7 days or 3 months). Leave blank to continue indefinitely.

edit_dose_details.title: Edit dose
edit_dose_details.description: Change this dose and save to replace it. Editing only the schedule keeps the same entity; changing the time or medications starts a fresh entity (its history resets).

add_supply.title: Track a medication supply
add_supply.description: Count how much of a medication is on hand. It decrements each time a dose containing this medication is marked given, flags low at your threshold, and estimates a run-out date from the schedule. Pick the medication from your doses.

data.supply_cost: Cost per unit (0 = do not track)
data.supply_refills: Refills remaining on prescription (0 = do not track)

data_description.supply_refill_add: On refill, add the refill amount to what is left (e.g. 17 + 30 = 47) instead of setting the count to the refill amount.
data_description.supply_cost: Cost of one unit (a pill, ml, etc.) in your currency, used for the value-on-hand and cost-per-dose attributes. Leave at 0 to skip cost tracking.
data_description.supply_refills: How many refills the prescription still allows. Each time you press the refill button, this counts down by one, and the supply flags as low when it reaches zero so you know to reorder. Leave at 0 to skip refill tracking.
data_description.supply_unit: The unit this medication is counted in (tablets, drops, ml, syringes, pens, ...). Pick one or type your own. It is shown next to the count and the dose amount, e.g. '30 tablets'. Leave blank for a plain number.

medication_detail.title: Medication detail
medication_detail.description: Optional reference info for a medication, kept separate from the short dose name. Pick a medication from this patient's doses; saving detail for one that already has it updates it.

settings.title: Reminder settings
settings.description: Patient type, who to notify, time display, when doses reset for the day, and how the reminders nag.

data_description.nag_interval: Use a multiple of 5; reminders are evaluated on a 5-minute tick, so other values re-nag less evenly.
data_description.skip_buttons: For doses that group two or more meds, add a button per med that marks the dose given while skipping that one med (its supply is not counted). Off by default; turn on if a med in a grouped dose is sometimes missing.
data_description.plan_view: Add an opt-in per-day plan for filling a pill organiser: a plan sensor and a day-offset number (0 = today) for stepping through days. The bundled dashboards show it as a table of each day's meds and amounts per time slot. Off by default.
data_description.pause_switches: Add a pause toggle to each scheduled dose. Turn it on to suspend that med until you switch it back off, e.g. when a doctor puts it on hold or it is seasonal: no reminders, not flagged as missed, and no supply counted down. It stays paused across days, unlike skip today, which is one day only. Off by default.
data_description.streak: Add a per-patient sensor that tracks consecutive days every scheduled dose was taken, plus the longest streak, the last missed day, and an adherence percentage over the last 30 days. A skipped dose keeps the streak but lowers the percentage; a missed dose breaks it. Off by default. It keeps a small per-day history so it can show past streaks.
